reinstall.title: Reinstall Adapter
reinstall.descriptionPre: This will pull the latest version of
reinstall.descriptionPost: from npm and hot-swap the running adapter module. Existing agents will use the new version on their next run.

installDialog.title: Install External Adapter
installDialog.description: Add an adapter from npm or a local path. The adapter package must export createServerAdapter().
installDialog.localPathHint: Accepts Linux, WSL, and Windows paths. Windows paths are auto-converted.

alpha.title: External adapters are alpha.
alpha.description: The adapter plugin system is under active development. APIs and storage format may change. Use the power icon to hide adapters from agent menus without removing them.

externalSection.title: External Adapters
externalSection.emptyHint: Install an adapter package to extend model support.

removeDialog.title: Remove Adapter
removeDialog.descriptionPre: Are you sure you want to remove the
removeDialog.descriptionMid: adapter? It will be unregistered and removed from the adapter store.
removeDialog.npmCleanup: npm packages will be cleaned up from disk.

instructionsFile.label: Agent instructions file
instructionsFile.hintDefault: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime.
instructionsFile.hintCursor: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the prompt at runtime.
instructionsFile.hintGemini: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Prepended to the Gemini prompt at runtime.
instructionsFile.hintCodex: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime. Note: Codex may still auto-apply repo-scoped AGENTS.md files from the workspace.

configFields.fastModeWarnActive: Fast mode consumes credits/tokens much faster than standard Codex runs.
configFields.fastModeWarnUnsupported: Fast mode currently only works on {{models}}. Paperclip will ignore this toggle until the model is switched.
configFields.deviceAuthHint: Always enabled for gateway agents. Paperclip persists a device key during onboarding so pairing approvals remain stable across runs.
